description: Actual introduced lexemes only; do not populate from planned word budgets or glossary entries alone.

expected_entry_schema.lexeme_id: stable sense-disambiguated ID e.g. edo_eat_v3 (not interchangeable with edō='issue')
expected_entry_schema.english_gloss: brief licensed or original teacher-approved meaning
expected_entry_schema.lesson_path: repository-relative JSON file for a complete authored Latin lesson
expected_entry_schema.sentence_id: identifier of first contextual reading sentence, not quiz-only text
expected_entry_schema.source_reference: provenance ID and licence for any borrowed lexicon data
expected_entry_schema.reviewed_by: actual owner or qualified Latinist signer, clearly identified by review_tier
expected_entry_schema.review_tier: owner (signed after Claude drafted; NOT checked by a Latinist) | latinist (qualified linguistic review)
expected_entry_schema.drafted_by: required for owner-tier; must differ from reviewed_by

counting_notes: Inflected surface forms are not new lexemes.
Proper names are not counted toward the Latin vocabulary minimum.
Spellings normalized without macrons are not sufficient to merge different headwords/senses.
Each entry needs a reviewed lesson with matching lexeme token and contextual sentence.
Always report owner-tier and Latinist-tier introductions separately, including both 1,500/3,000 completion gates.
Owner-reviewed entries are explicitly labelled NOT checked by a Latinist even when total approved word-count gates pass.
